subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by granting the selected CDP host across both hostname exception fields, or by passing a separate CDP-control policy into Playwright navigation/session helpers while leaving page-navigation policy unchanged?
rationale: The report is a real source-level mismatch, but the repair changes a browser SSRF control boundary and current tests encode part of the stricter behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before relaxing it.

options.title: Scope the fix to CDP control policy
options.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the selected profile's CDP control policy so local control traffic does not self-block.

options.title: Make the helper update both fields
options.body: Teach `withAllowedHostname` to also extend `hostnameAllowlist`, accepting the risk that any caller using the adjusted policy outside CDP control may broaden hostname matching.

options.title: Keep current strict behavior
options.body: Require users with `hostnameAllowlist` to include the local CDP host explicitly, and update docs/tests to make that operator burden intentional.

recommendation.title: Scope the fix to CDP control policy
recommendation.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the selected profile's CDP control policy so local control traffic does not self-block.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the shared helper refactor and already routed a closely related local-CDP SSRF cleanup discussion.
